Author: Serpens66
Name: Troop Movement Fix 2
Description: Preserves compatible Vanilla tribe movement across selection rebuilds, keeps Improved Spearmen synchronized, and maps Ctrl+move to Vanilla free-unit-speeds movement.

Changes: Prevent Vanilla unit-type handlers from interpreting a selection-only temporary tribe 0 as free maximum-speed movement.

Expose the unit's last valid Vanilla movement tribe only for the synchronous duration of its unchanged native type handler, then immediately restore tribe 0 so selection rebuilding and later commands remain Vanilla.
Apply the guard generically to observed moving units instead of special-casing Archer, Spearman, or any other unit type.
Capture the authoritative Vanilla tribe movement state before the mouse-selection or bottom-bar selection helper clears and rebuilds unit tribe assignments.
Keep the original Vanilla selection helpers fully active after the snapshot so selection, UI, and tribe rebuilding behavior remain unchanged.
Hook Vanilla's selection-only final tribe-template copy and inherit the compatible previous tribe's movement-continuation state before unit handlers can observe the new tribe.
Capture the authoritative tribe movement state at the selection boundary instead of reusing a potentially stale immediate post-order snapshot.

Preserve the native leader speed seeds, transition seed, free-speed flag, synchronized speed fields, patrol mode, and adjacent movement-continuation fields without writing unit speed bonuses or animations.
Log the per-unit Vanilla transition timer for diagnostics without modifying it.
Remove the 1.0.7 pre-selection speed-bonus and animation restoration which could block Vanilla's legitimate slowdown after deselection.
Prepare synchronized speed and cadence fallback data only from a completed real Vanilla DefaultInSync order.
Expose that fallback for a concrete unit only while Vanilla temporarily leaves it at tribe zero during selection rebuilding.
Return immediately to Vanilla behavior as soon as the unit has any valid tribe ID; Ctrl/Fast and the permanent mixed-group Improved Spearman correction remain unchanged.
Use each unit's settled Vanilla speed bonus and walk/run animation immediately before selection instead of the potentially transient immediate post-order snapshot.
Restore selection-changed speed bonus and animation immediately after Vanilla recalculates a tracked DefaultInSync unit.
Keep the settled cadence through the existing unit-bound directive while Vanilla temporarily leaves the unit at tribe zero.
Report preserved walking, preserved running, and immediate cadence-restoration counts in the capped selection summary.
Preserve compatible existing tribes at the selection boundary, covering unit types which stay in their current tribe while Vanilla changes that tribe's synchronized movement speed.
Require every living tribe member to have the same known movement state before restoring any existing tribe.
Add compact Info diagnostics for restored, unchanged, and rejected existing-tribe candidates.
Preserve the synchronized speed and walk/run cadence established by the last real DefaultInSync order when Vanilla recalculates a running unit because of selection.
Activate the unit-bound preservation only for units actually observed in the post-selection movement calculation; Fast/Ctrl movement remains entirely on Vanilla freeUnitSpeeds.
Keep the later compatible-tribe field restoration so both stages of Vanilla's selection rebuild retain the last real order.
Let Vanilla rebuild selected tribes normally, then preserve only the five group movement fields established by the units' last real order.
Apply selection preservation only when every assigned tracked unit has the same known movement state; ambiguous groups remain Vanilla.
Keep the implementation group-bound and event-driven instead of restoring general per-unit speed, animation, or cadence values.
Retain capped Info diagnostics for verification of selection rebuilds and movement-field preservation.
Correct the Script Extender GameTribe pointer offset so Ctrl writes Vanilla freeUnitSpeeds at the actual native field.
Remove the ineffective selection-marker restoration and leave selection fully Vanilla.
Add capped Info diagnostics for mouse/UI selection, tracked tribe assignments, and Vanilla movement-state recalculation without writing captured values back.
Document that the original TroopMovementFix already works and Fix2 exists to achieve the result with less intervention.
Preserve the exact per-unit Vanilla movement marker changed by DLL_TroopSelection instead of relying on movement-order events that selection changes bypass.
Map Ctrl+move to Vanilla's native freeUnitSpeeds tribe state while leaving the ordinary movement argument and all per-unit speed calculations to the game.
Keep the native speed and cadence correction restricted to Improved Spearmen in mixed synchronized groups.
Use Vanilla Fast movement directly for Ctrl+move without custom per-unit maximum-speed or animation overrides.
Preserve selection state by remembering only each unit's last Vanilla movement mode and correcting conflicting internal continuations.
Restrict native speed and cadence correction to Improved Spearmen in mixed synchronized groups and move operational logging to Info.
Preserve synchronized and free-speed mixed-group movement when the running units are selected again or clicked in the bottom selection bar.
Keep Improved Spearmen at the synchronized group speed in mixed Vanilla movement without limiting homogeneous or Fast movement.
Map Ctrl+move to Vanilla's existing Fast mode so the game calculates every unit's own maximum speed and running cadence.
